name: Coherent
summary: Coherent appears in Part 11 of The Buildout. Part 11: The Backlog Is Not the Quarter.

parts.headline: The Backlog Is Not the Quarter

mentions.excerpt: Gaetano's version is arithmetic: with Coherent selling everything it can make, Gaetano's illustration has demand running 30% above supply, so that a 15% cut in expected demand still leaves the company growing as capacity ramps, which, Gaetano wrote on September 15, is a different world from idle factories.
Gaetano's September 15 list of the money behind the orders runs from Tower's prepayments to Coherent's minimum-demand guarantees and Lumentum's take-or-pay terms.
The optics ramp has no date yet; Ciena, Lumentum and Coherent will each report in their own time.
